<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：北の峠　第４マーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">エピック・イベントの値を計算する場合、この位置は計算に入らない。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">エピック・イベントの値を計算する場合、この位置は計算に入らない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-North-Ridge-4th-Marker-PSA-152940010.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: North Ridge, 4th Marker.

'''Light Side:'''
This site does not count when calculating an Epic Event.

'''Dark Side:'''
This site does not count when calculating an Epic Event.
